statement_nl: There exist rational functions G_0(q), ..., G_n(q) and polynomials A_0(q), B_0(q), A_n(q), B_n(q) in Z[q] such that H_{d,r,n,k}(q) = G_k(q) - G_{k+1}(q) for every 0 <= k <= n-1, gcd(B_0(q), M_n(q)) = 1, gcd(B_n(q), M_n(q)) = 1, G_0(q) = M_n(q) A_0(q)/B_0(q), and G_n(q) = M_n(q) A_n(q)/B_n(q).
